column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each core record (e.g., 'CRD001234').
A TIMESTAMP(6) indicating when the record was created (e.g., '2025-02-19 14:23:15.123456').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing the customer ID (e.g., 'CUST00987').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing the application ID (e.g., 'APP001122').
A VARCHAR(10) storing the model or version reference (e.g., '1.2').
A DATE capturing when scoring took place (e.g., '2025-02-19').
A DATE noting the next review date (e.g., '2026-02-19').
A NUMERIC(5,3) tracking data quality (e.g., '0.975').
A NUMERIC(5,3) indicating confidence in the model’s output (e.g., '0.835').
An enum (OverrideStatus_enum) describing override status (Policy, Manual).
An enum (OverrideReason_enum) capturing why an override occurred (Policy Exception, Management Decision).
An enum (DecisionStatus_enum) storing the final decision (Pending, Rejected, Approved).
A DATE recording when the final decision was made (e.g., '2025-02-19').
A SMALLINT for the customer’s age in years (e.g., '35').
An enum (Gender_enum) for gender (M, F).
An enum (MaritalStatus_enum) capturing marital status (Single, Married, Widowed, Divorced).
A SMALLINT counting how many dependents (e.g., '2').
An enum (ResidentialStatus_enum) describing residency (Temporary, Permanent, Foreign).
A SMALLINT indicating address stability (e.g., '5').
A SMALLINT for phone number stability (e.g., '3').
A VARCHAR(50) capturing email stability or validation result (e.g., 'Valid12m').
An enum (CustomerSegment_enum) labeling the customer segment (Premium, Standard, Basic).
A SMALLINT for how many years the customer has been with the institution (e.g., '4').
A NUMERIC(4,3) ratio measuring cross-sell opportunities (e.g., '0.275').
A NUMERIC(4,3) indicating profitability (e.g., '0.765').
A NUMERIC(4,3) risk of customer churn (e.g., '0.220').
